task_tags_owner_access.name: task_tags_owner_access
task_tags_owner_access.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE tasks.id = task_tags.task_id AND tasks.user_id = (select ((current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true))::jsonb ->> 'sub')::uuid))
task_tags_owner_access.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE tasks.id = task_tags.task_id AND tasks.user_id = (select ((current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true))::jsonb ->> 'sub')::uuid))

tasks_effort_check.name: tasks_effort_check
tasks_effort_check.value: effort IS NULL OR effort BETWEEN 1 AND 3

tasks_effort_origin_check.name: tasks_effort_origin_check
tasks_effort_origin_check.value: effort_origin IS NULL OR (effort IS NOT NULL AND effort_origin IN ('manual', 'accepted'))

tasks_timed_zone_check.name: tasks_timed_zone_check
tasks_timed_zone_check.value: scheduled_start IS NULL OR zone IS NOT NULL

tasks_end_needs_start_check.name: tasks_end_needs_start_check
tasks_end_needs_start_check.value: scheduled_start IS NOT NULL OR scheduled_end IS NULL

tasks_end_on_check.name: tasks_end_on_check
tasks_end_on_check.value: end_on IS NULL OR (due_on IS NOT NULL AND end_on >= due_on)

tasks_timed_end_on_check.name: tasks_timed_end_on_check
tasks_timed_end_on_check.value: scheduled_start IS NULL OR end_on IS NULL
